First, 22 weeks and 6 days = 22 × 7 + 6 = 154 + 6 = 160 days.  
Start date: 1270-09-23.  
Add 160 days:  
September 23 → September 30 = 7 days (remain 153 days).  
October has 31 days → 153 - 31 = 122 days left.  
November has 30 days → 122 - 30 = 92 days left.  
December has 31 days → 92 - 31 = 61 days left.  
January 1271 has 31 days → 61 - 31 = 30 days left.  
February 1271 has 28 days (not leap year in 1271) → 30 - 28 = 2 days left.  
March 1271: add 2 days → March 2, 1271.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1271-03-02
